summary: Bound draft release metadata while preserving full notes

replay.detail: No runtime replay or projection changes.

rules.detail: Draft metadata is bounded by UTF-8 bytes. Exact artifact verification and publication approval are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Complete release notes and upgrade impact remain attached as assets.

manual.detail: No operator action is required for existing releases.

recovery.detail: Operators can retry draft preparation with the same exact source and verified build.
